The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
数据目的操作类型，可取值：

- **REPUBLISH**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至物联网平台的另一个通信Topic。
- **AMQP**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据流转到AMQP消费组。
- **DATAHUB**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云DataHub，进行流式数据处理。
- **ONS**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云消息队列RocketMQ，进行消息分发。
- **MNS**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云消息服务中，进行消息传输。
- **FC**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云函数计算服务，进行事件计算。
- **OTS**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云表格存储（Tablestore），进行NoSQL数据存储。
description.en:
The operation type of the data destination. Valid values:

- **REPUBLISH**: Forward topic data processed by the resolver script to another communication topic in IoT Platform.
- **AMQP**: Forward topic data processed by the resolver script to an AMQP consumer group.
- **DATAHUB**: Forward topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for stream data processing.
- **ONS**: Forward topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud Message Queue for Apache RocketMQ for message distribution.
- **MNS**: Send topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
- **FC**: Send topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute for event-based computing.
- **OTS**: Send topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

调用接口[CreateDestination](~~433032~~)创建数据目的成功后，若有业务需要，您可根据返回的**DestinationId**更新对应数据目的信息。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To

After you successfully create a data destination by calling the [CreateDestination](~~433032~~) API, you can update the corresponding data destination information based on the returned **DestinationId** if required by your business.

## QPS Limit

Each Alibaba Cloud account can send up to 10 queries per second (QPS) when calling this API.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-destination --configuration topic_:_/a1POX0c0000/device1/user/get_,_topicType_:1 --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --destination-id 1002 --type REPUBLISH --name DataPurpose --description '数据流转至另一个Topic。' --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot UpdateDestination --region cn-hangzhou --Type REPUBLISH --Description '数据流转至另一个Topic。' --Configuration 'topic_:_/a1POX0c0000/device1/user/get_,_topicType_:1' --IotInstanceId 'iot-2w0000' --DestinationId 1002 --Name DataPurpose
